notes.title: Castle Agony Major Update
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone
[/b]
It has been a very long time since there has been an update to Castle Agony, but I'm excited to announce a very large one!

I've been working very hard over the last few months making huge improvements, changing the combat system under the hood, bug fixing and adding a new content to aid you in your vampire slaying.

Here is a list of new Content!
[list]
[*] Changed character movement, the screen now moves much smoother and the player character walks faster in general
[*] Large combat system changes to be more efficient (still looks the same to the user)
[*] Souls can now be collected as a reward after combat!
[*] Added a creepy shopkeeper, he appears in 2 different places in the world and you may purchase things from him using souls.
[*] Added Soul Bow weapon, uses collected souls as ammunition and can be bought from the Shopkeeper.
[*] Added a new craftable item 'Arrows'. These require 3 new materials to make: Sticks, Flint and Feather
[*] Bug fixes and crash fixes that were already in the base game.
[*] Two new steam achievements!
[/list]

This will corrupt current saves as it was such a large update with new content but I hope you will all find that it's worth it. Combat rewards is definitely a game changer.

Enjoy fearless vampire killers!

notes.title: V1.1.1 Patch
notes.content:
[h1]Hot fIx Patch 1.1.1[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that crashed to desktop in Noctule's room. There was a crash if you clicked on an environment object before initiating combat with Noctule.
[*] Added Additional information in the first combat tutorial window that explains that your SKILL is a shared stat and is used as a dodge when the enemy attack.
[*] Fixed potential crash to desktop. When you Enter Lilly's Garden Shrine in the West wing and trigger the cutscene when Harry isn't in the room - this would could potentially cause a crash.

[h1]Wall of Honour[/h1]
[b]Manti-Core[/b] - for discovering the Noctule bug and suggestting additional info for the tutorial.

Thank you all for your support :)

notes.title: V1.1 Patch
notes.content:
A new version of Castle Agony has been uploaded. With minor tweaks and changes.


[b]V1.1 Notes.[/b]
[list]
[*] Minor tweaks made to loot tables.
[*] Moved the Chemical Note Book to the Flesh Door Room.
[*] Moved the Arsnic Vial to the Flesh Door Room.
[*] Added missing Mouse-Over text in some areas.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32383158/e95d587f813f813135959338eddb7cdd4ee38a83.jpg[/img]

Hopefully this will make removing the Skin Door puzzle easier to solve. The above changes may not be updated in older made saves.

If there are any issues with the update please report them in the Bugs section.

Thank you!

notes.title: Post Release Notes
notes.content:
I'd like to thank everyone who has purchased and supported the game. I plan to make a number of small updates and address any bugs as they're discovered.

Currently in development is a DLC chapter that will be free in the next month or two. This will have a number of new features, from: new enemies, a new weapon or two and of course, new characters and environments to explore.

This addition will be a standalone game set during a different period following a different hero. Once the DLC is ready I will make an announcement and the button to launch it will magically appear on the main menu.

Again, Thank you so much for purchasing the game and supporting it in the future!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32383158/1a818d694af7d0526d8ce4ffe785a6412bcb4800.jpg[/img]
